name: dithering-frame-card
title: Dithering Frame Card
description: A readable content card surrounded by an animated ordered-dither shader frame.

@utility surface-raised.background: linear-gradient(to bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-color, var(--card)) 97%, white), var(--surface-bottom, color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-color, var(--card)) 95%, var(--foreground)))) padding-box, linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--surface-stroke-top, color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 75%, var(--foreground))), var(--surface-stroke-bottom, var(--border))) border-box
